description: Target manifest for Monsoon and Low-Pressure-System (LPS) Reliability Specialist, covering system dynamics, precipitation, and regime transition failure modes.

invariants.decomposed_evaluation: System dynamics (location, speed, deepening), precipitation (placement, intensity), and regime transitions must be evaluated independently without collapsing into an opaque single score.
invariants.anti_leakage: All evaluation features strictly constrained to issue time t0. Verification against gridded rainfall and RSMC synoptic charts sealed with 24h latency.
invariants.regime_awareness: Validation must be partitioned across Active Monsoon, Break Monsoon, and Transition phases.

targets.name: LPS Center Position Placement Error Exceedance
targets.description: LPS center placement error exceeding 200 km at 48h/72h forecast lead.

targets.name: LPS Propagation Speed and Timing Error Exceedance
targets.description: LPS translation speed error exceeding 5 km/h or landfall/arrival timing error exceeding 12 hours.

targets.name: LPS Central Pressure Deepening Error Exceedance
targets.description: Forecast 24h central pressure deepening error exceeding 4 hPa.

targets.name: Monsoon Rainfall Centroid Placement Displacement Exceedance
targets.description: Monsoon heavy rainfall centroid displacement error exceeding 100 km.

targets.name: Monsoon Heavy Precipitation Intensity Error Exceedance
targets.description: Forecast 24h heavy rainfall intensity error exceeding 50 mm/24h.

targets.name: Active-Break Monsoon Regime Transition Timing and Stability Failure
targets.description: Forecast transition between active and break monsoon regimes with timing error exceeding 24 hours or false transition prediction.
